addons.name: release-policy-v17
addons.reason: Adapt the previously reviewed fork Python certification tooling and examples to released upstream v0.17.0.

addons.name: prime-native-v17
addons.reason: Port the existing Prime native addon onto the released v0.17.0 source and retain its verification entry points.

addons.name: skill-command-recovery-v17
addons.reason: Port durable skill invocation claims, unknown admission recovery, REQUEST reevaluation and saved-history replay guards; retain v0.17 route semantics.

addons.name: prime-verification-map
addons.reason: Document Prime as the thirteenth native provider and link the maintained CLI, terminal and HTTP verification entry points.

addons.name: prime-preflight-types-and-comment-audit
addons.reason: Apply the addon comment audit and repair the Prime preflight test collaborators with the actual typed client and process-manager interfaces.

addons.name: fork-installation-guide
addons.reason: Direct fork users to verified released assets and the maintained installation and upgrade instructions.

addons.name: skill-recovery-documentation-repair
addons.reason: Include the history-resume replay regression suite in the documented command-recovery checks; close independent review finding DOC-001.

addons.name: fork-version-v17
addons.reason: Stamp all four packages, runtime version and sibling lock records as 0.17.0+mdsmithaustin.1; preserve all upstream third-party records.

addons.name: native-ownership-filelock-floor
addons.reason: Require the frozen and tested filelock 3.29.1 API for asynchronous native ownership locking without changing resolved third-party artifacts.

addons.name: native-source-stop-authority
addons.reason: Persist the typed source owner, admission epoch and exact Stop outcome; check qualified closure in the destination insertion transaction.

addons.name: native-source-stop-runtime
addons.reason: Fence native creation and deferred input with their original source admission, serialize Prime requests and physical close, expose honest owner Stop outcomes and reader fork behavior.

addons.name: native-stop-schema-and-comment-audit
addons.reason: Regenerate the published Stop result schema, remove seven scoped prose units, and name the existing wrapper lock ownership predicate without changing the lock protocol.
